blurb: Guests receive massage therapy or acupuncture treatments from registered practitioners. Treatments vary in duration and focus on pain relief, health improvement, and relaxation. The clinic operates 7 days a week with multiple therapists available.
extraNote: At least 24 hours notice required to cancel or reschedule; less than 24 hours or no show requires full payment · Therapists may refuse treatment for policy breaches or inappropriate behavior · Clinic is on the second floor, access via stairs only. Not wheelchair accessible.
